Name: Fable: Coin Golf
Description: Ideaworks' pinball-golf spin-off of Fable III. Putt a coin through 45 courses across Albion, felling trees, squashing enemies and building bridges with three power-ups, then send the gold you win over to your Fable III save.

Achievements.Name: Brunel's Apprentice
Achievements.Description: Build 3 bridges in a single shot
